brief:
Israeli occupation forces closed multiple roads providing access to the Ras Al-Ayn area in the town of Qasreh, Shehab Wire reported. The blockade affected transit routes into the locality, restricting movement in and out of the region.

The closure represents the latest in a series of access restrictions imposed on Palestinian communities. No immediate statement was issued regarding the duration of the road closures or the stated military rationale behind the measure.
